author: Jinyuan
description: Prototype new workspace experiences and interaction patterns.
long_description: Tab Template is a development-oriented starting point for building new workspace experiences inside Semestra. It gives plugin authors a clean reference for structure, settings flow, and host integration so ideas can move from experiment to implementation quickly. It is most useful when exploring new product directions or validating a concept before investing in a more complete build.

tabs.title: Tab Template
tabs.description: Starter tab with editable settings and layout scaffolding.
